description: Use of Sydenham Road and Stoney Creek Road by heavy vehicles is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Government. The two main routes for commercial vehicles to the northwest and southwest from Botany-Mascot and Sydenham Road are Stoney Creek Road respectively. They carry about 17.0 - 19.9% of commercial vehicles. About one-third of the commercial vehicles are semi-trailers, and about one-sixth of the commercial vehicles carry containers. Coverage: NSW Government. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Government. Its tags are Roads and Traffic Authority of New South Wales. It offers 1 resource(s) in PDF. The portal shows 2026-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is licence code "lsba" on the portal (not expanded on the listing). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
